slopmatica.menu.title: Slopmatica
slopmatica.menu.keybinds_hint: Keybinds: Options > Key Binds... (or Controls > Key Binds)
slopmatica.browser.title: Load Schematic
slopmatica.placements.title: Loaded Placements
slopmatica.materials.title: Material List: %s
slopmatica.options.title: Slopmatica Options
slopmatica.options.show_ghosts.tooltip: Draw the missing blocks as see-through ghosts. Outlines are controlled separately.
slopmatica.options.ghost_opacity.tooltip: How solid ghost blocks look. Lower is more see-through.
slopmatica.options.show_outlines.tooltip: Turns every outline on or off at once (there is a hotkey for this in Key Binds). The per-colour switches below are kept as they are.
slopmatica.options.outline_missing.toolt: Outline blocks that have not been placed yet.
slopmatica.options.outline_match.tooltip: Outline blocks that exactly match the schematic.
slopmatica.options.outline_variant.toolt: Outline blocks of the right kind in the wrong state: facing, half, waxed vs unwaxed copper, oxidation and so on.
slopmatica.options.outline_wrong.tooltip: Outline blocks that are a different block entirely.
slopmatica.options.outline_width.tooltip: 100% is half as thick as vanilla's block outline, seen from 6 blocks away. Outlines have a fixed thickness in the world, so they get thinner with distance just like the blocks do.
slopmatica.options.fade_outlines.tooltip: Fade blue and green outlines with distance so large builds stay readable. Yellow and red never fade.
slopmatica.keys.title: Slopmatica Key Binds
slopmatica.options.paste_replace.none.to: Pasting only fills empty space; blocks already in the world stay.
slopmatica.options.paste_replace.with_no: The schematic's blocks overwrite what is in the way. Its air leaves things alone.
slopmatica.options.paste_replace.all.too: An exact copy: the schematic's air clears whatever is there too.
slopmatica.menu.copy.tooltip: Copy the selection (set its corners with the Set Selection Corner key) to schematics/copies/
slopmatica.menu.paste.tooltip: Load the last copy under your crosshair and position it in the placement view
slopmatica.view.title: Placement View
slopmatica.view.paste.tooltip: Build this placement into the world (creative only). What it may overwrite is set in Options.
slopmatica.view.reset.tooltip: Put it back where it was when the placement view opened
slopmatica.view.forward: Nudge away from the camera (Shift: 5 blocks)
slopmatica.view.up.label: Up
slopmatica.view.down.label: Down
slopmatica.view.rotate_ccw.label: Rotate L
slopmatica.view.rotate_cw.label: Rotate R
slopmatica.view.mirror.label: Mirror
slopmatica.browser.upload.tooltip: Copy this schematic into schematics/cloud/ and upload it. It then appears in every game logged in with your Minecraft account.
slopmatica.cloud.title: Slopmatica Cloud
slopmatica.cloud.hint: Cloud schematics are kept in schematics/cloud/
slopmatica.options.exit_view_when_hurt.t: In survival and adventure, taking damage closes the placement view so you can deal with whatever is hurting you. Creative is never affected.
slopmatica.options.view_collision.toolti: The placement view's camera bumps into blocks like you do. Turn off to fly through walls (noclip). Ghost blocks never block it.
slopmatica.options.copy_format.slopmatic: Slopmatica's own format: small files, fast to load. Recommended.
slopmatica.options.copy_format.nbt.toolt: Vanilla structure files, for structure blocks and /place template. Much bigger files for large builds.
slopmatica.options.copy_format.litematic: Litematica's format, for sharing with Litematica users.
slopmatica.options.block_info.tooltip: Top right: the schematic block under your crosshair, its status, and for yellow and red blocks exactly what differs (placed → wanted).
slopmatica.options.include_nbt.tooltip: Copy and paste block data (chest contents, sign text, banner patterns) and entities (item frames, armor stands, paintings, mobs). Off: blocks only.
slopmatica.options.easy_place_on.tooltip: Right-click a missing ghost block to place exactly that block, facing the right way. The item is taken from your hotbar or inventory (in creative, made for you). Hold right click to keep placing. Has a toggle key in Key Binds.
slopmatica.options.easy_place_restrict.t: While Easy Place is on, placing a block where the schematic wants a different block (or air) is refused. Using doors, levers, chests and the like still works.
slopmatica.easy_place.no_support: Easy Place: nothing next to the %s to place it against (Angel Placement in Options allows mid-air)
slopmatica.easy_place.refused: Easy Place: the schematic wants %s here
slopmatica.easy_place.refused_air: Easy Place: the schematic wants this spot empty
slopmatica.options.easy_place_rotate.too: Easy Place briefly turns you to the facing a block needs, for that one click (angle placement, as Litematica does; most servers allow it). Off: you are never turned; blocks that need a facing are only placed when you look that way, and you are told which way.
slopmatica.easy_place.face: Easy Place: face %s to place this
slopmatica.options.easy_place_angel.tool: Easy Place can place blocks floating in mid-air, with nothing next to them, as Litematica does. Vanilla servers accept it; some anti-cheat plugins don't. Placing against a neighbour is still preferred when that gives the right block.
slopmatica.cloud.password.tooltip: Opens your account page on the website, already logged in. Set a password there to log in on the website directly with your Minecraft name, without the game.
slopmatica.options.advanced.tooltip: Show the technical settings too: outline thickness and fading, per-colour switches, file formats, the cloud server address...
slopmatica.options.solid_ghosts.tooltip: Draw ghost blocks fully solid instead of see-through. Easier to read a build's shape, harder to see what is behind it.
slopmatica.options.color.tooltip: Pick this outline colour, e.g. to make the statuses easier to tell apart with colour blindness.
slopmatica.options.view_freecam.tooltip: The placement view flies a camera away from you. Off: you stay in your body and walk as usual; the view's clicks, keys and buttons still work.
slopmatica.options.easy_place_order.furt: Places the furthest missing ghost block on your crosshair line (the line goes through ghosts, up to the first real block), so blocks placed near you never block the way to ones further off.
slopmatica.options.easy_place_order.near: Places the nearest missing ghost block on your crosshair line.
slopmatica.options.controls_keys.tooltip: Choose which Slopmatica keys are listed in Minecraft's own Controls screen, so it isn't flooded. All keys work and can be changed here either way.
slopmatica.options.cloud_url.tooltip: The Slopmatica Cloud server. Only change this if you run your own.
slopmatica.controls_keys.title: Keys: Controls Menu and Quick Actions
slopmatica.controls_keys.tooltip: Whether this key is listed in Minecraft's Controls screen. It works either way.
slopmatica.color.title: %s Outline Colour
slopmatica.menu.credits.tooltip: Made by Sputniknull + Claude. Opens the website's page for bug reports and suggestions.
slopmatica.menu.update: Slopmatica %s is out: click to update (installed when you close Minecraft)
slopmatica.menu.update_pending: Slopmatica %s is downloaded and will be installed when you close Minecraft
slopmatica.welcome.title: Welcome to Slopmatica
slopmatica.welcome.intro: A few things to set up. All of it can be changed later in Options.
slopmatica.welcome.login.tooltip: Links this game to Slopmatica Cloud with your Minecraft account: your schematics sync between computers and you can use the website. No password needed.
slopmatica.welcome.import.tooltip: No Litematica settings in this instance. You can import them from another instance or folder.
slopmatica.welcome.import.found.tooltip: Litematica settings were found in this instance. Your schematics folder is already shared with Litematica.
slopmatica.welcome.skip.tooltip: Close without changing keys or telemetry. Login and imports you already did stay.
slopmatica.options.telemetry.tooltip: Sends anonymous usage data to the Slopmatica cloud server to help find slow spots and unused features: frame times and computer specs while schematics are shown, which settings are changed and which keys are used, and whether a schematic came from the cloud. Off unless you turn it on.
slopmatica.options.import_litematica.too: Copy your Litematica settings and keys, from this instance or another one.
slopmatica.import.title: Import from Litematica
slopmatica.import.from: From %s, only what you changed in Litematica:
slopmatica.import.nothing: Nothing to import: everything there is at Litematica's defaults.
slopmatica.import.not_found: No litematica.json there. Pick an instance folder, its config folder, or the file.
slopmatica.welcome.key.tooltip: %s. Click, then press a key or mouse button. Escape cancels.
slopmatica.tool.move.tooltip: Drag the build to slide it along the ground. While flying, left click picks it up and puts it down.
slopmatica.tool.select.tooltip: Click two blocks to set the selection's corners. Ghost blocks count, so you can select parts that aren't built yet.
slopmatica.tool.modify.tooltip: Drag a face of the selection box to grow or shrink it.
slopmatica.tool.crop.tooltip: Drag a face of the build's orange box so only part of it shows. Material lists and pasting use only the part that shows.
slopmatica.tool.needs_cursor: %s: right click for the cursor, then drag a face
slopmatica.tool.modify.none: No selection yet: set two corners with the Select tool first
slopmatica.tool.selection.copy.tooltip: Save the selection as a schematic (the same as the copy key).
slopmatica.layers.tooltip: Show every layer, one layer, or everything below or above a layer. Applies to all builds, including Easy Place and block info.
slopmatica.layers.here.tooltip: Move the layer to the height you're standing at.
slopmatica.builds.title: Builds
slopmatica.panel.select_hint: Left click: show only selected materials
slopmatica.panel.selected: Selected: only selected materials show (left click to unselect)
slopmatica.panel.ignore_hint: Right click: leave out of the count
slopmatica.panel.ignored: Ignored (right click to count it again)
slopmatica.panel.hint: L: show only   R: ignore   P: pin
slopmatica.menu.spawn.tooltip: Marks every spot in the selection (or the selected build) where hostile mobs can spawn, using vanilla's rules. Purple: dark even by day. Pink: only at night.
slopmatica.spawn.no_area: Spawn check: select an area or load a build first
slopmatica.spawn.too_big: Spawn check: area too big (%s blocks, at most %s). Select a smaller area.
slopmatica.spawn.title: Spawn check
slopmatica.spawn.none: No spots where mobs can spawn
slopmatica.spawn.always: %s spots dark even by day (no sky light)
slopmatica.browser.modded: Modded (%s): stays on this computer, not synced to the cloud or posted to the board
slopmatica.menu.plan.tooltip: What to bring for the next part of the build, packed into your free slots and shulker boxes.
slopmatica.plan.title: Inventory Plan
slopmatica.plan.scope.next_bottom_up.too: The blocks still missing, lowest layer first, as many as fit.
slopmatica.plan.scope.next_top_down.tool: The blocks still missing, highest layer first, as many as fit.
slopmatica.plan.scope.layers.tooltip: The layers the layer view shows (all of them when it's off).
slopmatica.plan.scope.current_layer.tool: One layer: the layer view's, or the one you're standing at.
slopmatica.plan.scope.selection.tooltip: Only the blocks inside the selection box.
slopmatica.plan.auto_slots.tooltip: Use every empty slot in your inventory. Turn off to set how many slots to use.
slopmatica.plan.shulkers.tooltip: New shulker boxes you're willing to fill: up to 27 carried and 26 more in the ender chest. Boxes are only used once the free slots run out.
slopmatica.plan.unlimited.tooltip: Allow more shulker boxes than fit in an inventory plus an ender chest.
slopmatica.plan.carried.tooltip: Also fill the empty slots of shulker boxes you already carry.
slopmatica.plan.ignore_nbt.tooltip: Count what you carry whatever its data (renamed, enchanted...). Off: only plain items count.
slopmatica.plan.variants.tooltip: Bring plain logs and an axe for stripped wood, plain copper and honeycomb for waxed copper, and fully oxidized copper and an axe for exposed or weathered copper (scrape it back to the stage you need).
slopmatica.plan.show.tooltip: Ghost items in your empty inventory slots, and needed items outlined in chests (blue: exact, orange: a variant).
slopmatica.plan.ignored.tooltip: Items you right-clicked to leave out of the plan. Click to bring them back.
slopmatica.plan.header: %s stacks · %s new shulker boxes · %s in the ender chest · %s slots free
slopmatica.plan.truncated: Very large area: only the first part was planned.
slopmatica.plan.nothing: Nothing to bring: you carry everything needed.
slopmatica.plan.summary: Plan: %s stacks to bring (%s shulker boxes)
slopmatica.plan.summary_overflow: Plan: %s stacks (%s shulker boxes); %s kinds of items don't fit
slopmatica.plan.no_builds: Inventory plan: no build shown here
slopmatica.plan.no_selection: Inventory plan: no selection in this dimension
slopmatica.plan.row.ignore: Right click: leave out of the plan
slopmatica.plan.ender: + %s shulker boxes from the ender chest
slopmatica.options.share_schematics.tool: Show the schematics folder shared by every Minecraft instance on this computer as a "Shared" tab in the browser.
slopmatica.options.share_settings.toolti: This instance uses the settings shared by your other instances, and changes here go to them too. Turning it on takes the shared settings (or shares this instance's if there are none yet).
slopmatica.options.shared_folder.tooltip: Leave empty for the default folder, %s, which every new install checks on its own. Another folder works, but each instance has to be pointed at it.
slopmatica.options.shared_folder.warning: Custom shared folder set. New installs won't find it on their own: they only look in %s.
slopmatica.browser.tab.shared.tooltip: Schematics shared by every instance on this computer: %s
slopmatica.welcome.shared: Use Settings From My Other Instances
slopmatica.welcome.shared.tooltip: Another Minecraft instance on this computer shares its Slopmatica settings. Use them here too (and the shared schematics folder).
slopmatica.options.dev_overlay.tooltip: A graph of frame times with averages and the hologram's rebuild stats, bottom left. Also /slopmatica dev overlay.
slopmatica.options.dev_build.tooltip: Adds a synthetic build (about 60% filled with a mix of tricky blocks) at your feet. Test builds aren't saved; also /slopmatica dev stress x y z.
slopmatica.options.dev_copies.tooltip: Many placements at once, in a grid beside the selected build. Also /slopmatica dev copies <n>.
slopmatica.cloud.apply.tooltip: Slopmatica Cloud is for players on the Fruitbowl server. Opens the website's application form.
slopmatica.cloud.profiles.tooltip: Keep your Slopmatica settings in the cloud and use the same ones in other instances and on other computers.
slopmatica.profiles.title: Settings Profiles
slopmatica.profiles.intro: Choose the settings this instance follows (%s of %s profiles used)
slopmatica.profiles.use: Use these settings here and keep them in sync. Last changed %s.
slopmatica.profiles.delete: Delete this profile (instances using it keep their current settings)
slopmatica.profiles.name: New profile name
slopmatica.profiles.save.tooltip: Save this instance's settings as a new profile, and follow it.
slopmatica.profiles.stop.tooltip: Keep this instance's settings to itself. The profiles stay in the cloud.
slopmatica.profiles.intro_unknown: Choose the settings this instance follows
slopmatica.options.copy_format.schem.too: WorldEdit's .schem (Sponge format, version 3): for pasting with WorldEdit or FAWE.
slopmatica.options.outline_distance.tool: How far blue and green outlines reach before they fade, like Entity Distance: 100% fades from 24 to 48 blocks, 200% from 48 to 96.
slopmatica.options.corner_mode.dynamic.t: The corner key marks the block you look at, or where you stand when you look at nothing.
slopmatica.options.corner_mode.look.tool: The corner key only marks the block you look at.
slopmatica.options.corner_mode.feet.tool: The corner key always marks where you stand.
slopmatica.selection.look_at_block: Look at a block to mark a corner
slopmatica.view.no_build: No build selected: use the Select tool to make a selection
slopmatica.view.undo.tooltip: Undo the last move, turn, mirror, crop or selection change (Ctrl+Z).
slopmatica.view.fit.tooltip: Shrink the selection so there are no layers of air at its edges.
slopmatica.view.fit_nothing: Nothing to fit: the selection is empty (or there is none)
slopmatica.save.title: Save Selection
slopmatica.save.name: Schematic name
slopmatica.save.no_selection: No selection yet: mark two corners first
slopmatica.plan.forget.tooltip: Forget the plan when you leave a world. Off: it lasts until the game closes, and comes back when you rejoin that world.
slopmatica.plan.side.tooltip: The list beside your inventory: what doesn't fit, ender chest boxes and recommended tools. The X on it turns this off.
slopmatica.quick.hint.release: Let go of a number key to use · %s: customise
slopmatica.quick.hint.stay: Click to use; stays open · %s: customise
slopmatica.quick.edit.title: Quick Menu
slopmatica.quick.edit.help: Click an action, then a slot. Click two slots to swap; right click to empty.
slopmatica.quick.mode.click.tooltip: Pick a slot (scroll or number key), then left or right click. The menu closes.
slopmatica.quick.mode.release.tooltip: Runs the moment you let go of a number key. Scrolling only moves the selection.
slopmatica.quick.mode.stay_open.tooltip: Click to run; the menu stays open until you press the Quick Menu key again.
slopmatica.quick.edit.new_toggle.tooltip: A button that switches a setting between two values, or steps through a list.
slopmatica.quick.edit.values.tooltip: The values to step through, separated by commas. Leave empty for on/off settings, or to step through every choice of a list setting. Percent settings take percentages.
slopmatica.quick.edit.toggle_help: New toggle: pick the setting and the values (empty: on/off, or every choice). Right click a toggle in the list to delete it.
slopmatica.controls_keys.quick.tooltip: Click, then press a key to run this action with it (outside menus). Escape removes the key.
